name: cloudops
description: Natural-language DevOps & SRE on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure via aws, gcloud and az — deploy, provision, configure, scale, observe, troubleshoot

interface.longDescription: CLI-based skills that let an agent deploy services, rent servers, manage configuration, scale, read logs and metrics, and troubleshoot on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure using the official aws, gcloud and az CLIs — with explicit cost and destructive-action confirmation. Works with both Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
